'''Heen-Sa''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] in training. Heen-Sa was among the candidates [[Sophia Farash]] identified to the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] who was on [[Voss]] looking for an ally. Farash stated that Heen-Sa was sympathetic toward the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="A Thorny Path" />
